dates_comment: proposed values of LIVE_TESTS_7.md 1.1; the window slides later with LT6's END_UTC (a move is recorded in the ledger); the module constants must equal these (L6)
k_tests_rule: the tests whose census gate passes (section 7), a subset of [CH195, CH191, CH197, CH193, CH192]; fixed at registration, never changed; a size-scenario failure sets only its own tests to p = 1 (1.8); provisional k <= 5
code_sha_rule: normalised sha256 (SPEC_SHA256 line excluded) of live_tests7.py, live_tests7_analysis.py (phase 2), live_tests7_base.py, bounce_decomp.py and the hashed dependencies maker_rewards.py, panel.py, trade_sample.py, cb17_census.py, cb13_label.py, economics.py, forecast.py (8.1)

eligibility.rule: section 1.4: binary, not closed, active, two-sided (0 < bid < ask <= 1) and spread <= 0.10 (Gamma spread, else ask - bid) at k-1 and k; one row per market_id and per condition_id (first in page order)

sports_rule: cb17_census.is_sports_sidecar(fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs) on the sidecar of the capture; sidecar missing -> sports = -1 (unknown; excluded wherever the category is needed)

crypto_rule.rule: crypto = fee_type starts with 'crypto' or the first series slug matches slug_regex (section 13, finding 2)
crypto_rule.note: vendored-only: read by the copied category_cols; LT7 classifies crypto with crypto_classifier (the `crypto7` class), never with this rule

series_key_rule: first series slug if present, else 'event:' + event_id; crypto rows without a slug -> 'crypto:noslug' (one family: one spot driver)

move.class_rule: never_traded (ltp absent at k-1 and k) > traded (L or V+) > ambiguous (V-, ltp present at k-1 and absent at k, or volume24hr unknown) > quote_only (not L, V0); geometry for every unit: parallel (sign db = sign da = sign x, both >= 0.005, |db - da| <= 0.005), one_sided (min(|db|,|da|) <= 0.0005), spread_change (opposite signs, both > 0.0005), same_side_unequal (rest)

crypto_classifier.rule: 1.0 (LT6 R1 re-check R2): every primary excludes crypto by this classifier; unknown (sidecar missing, field absent / empty / null-like) is counted separately and treated as crypto; the crypto arm is reported, uncounted
crypto_classifier.failsafe: if no distinct fee_category value of the whole sealed sidecar set contains 'crypto' the classifier is not shown to work and every census is refused as NaN (fails)

CH195.first_origin_rule: first pass whose k - 1 capture and k - 1 sweep start at or after REGISTERED_UTC (12-08T02:31Z as proposed; the 12-08T00:31Z pass is lt6_boundary)

gates.perm_method: block circular-shift Freedman-Lane (CH195, CH191, CH193, CH192); plain Freedman-Lane within market (CH197) (LIVE_TESTS_7.md 1.8)

inference.p_rule: p = max(p_event on t with G_event - 1 df, p_two-way normal, p_day on t with G_day - 1 df); CH191's event df uses min(G_event, G_minor) - 1

size_check.rule: a failing scenario sets only the tests it is binding for to 'SE check failed'; p = 1, k unchanged; no rerun, reseed or variant; max_retries 1 covers a deterministic crash only (phase 2 code)

census_inputs.capture_seal: docs/research_lab/seals/lt7_census_inputs.json (written by run_live_tests7.py seal; committed before any LT7 census)
census_inputs.covered_days_rule: covered complete slots / 12 (CH192: covered declared slots / 4; CH197: covered 12:31Z passes; CV7: samples used / 12); below the minimum every gate of that census is NaN and fails
census_inputs.block_gate_share_proxy: ceil(16 x covered_days / 21) units of the test's population in the census days (R1 re-check must-fix 1)
census_inputs.projection: counts x 21 / covered days (an estimate); distinct events E_2d + (E_2d - E_day1) x 19 for two-day censuses, else covered-days scaling; effective = units in markets with >= 2 units of the test's population (CH197: markets present on both days)
census_inputs.fallback: fewer sealed slots: use exactly those (the rest genuinely missing, counted); no LT5 seal: q0600 hashes the same spans from the data releases' files.sha256; slots outside the named spans are never read; no other day is substituted

mde_common.rule: slope and class MDE gates: max(declared, design); F-MDE = max(declared form MDE x sqrt(2 / (1 - max(0, r_w))), design-based MDE of the contrast in the arm model); NaN fails; DE_gate = max(floor, 1 + (m_21 - 1) x 0.02); the census takes t_sum = max(3.47, exact computed t_{20,1-0.05/6} + t_{20,0.8}) (census-code check should-fix)

vendored_source_drift_rule: a vendored source file whose sha256 differs from live_tests7_base.VENDORED fails the provenance test unless an entry {file: {sha256, reason, date}} is recorded here (an explicit re-vendor decision; LT5 census code check finding 10); empty at the pin
